title: Geometry -> Resonance -> Sound: Pyramid / Stone-Chamber Converter Instruction
purpose: Convert real chamber geometry and measured or calculated acoustic resonances into reproducible audio parameters, while keeping physical acoustics separate from symbolic or creative interpretation.

confirmed_physics: Enclosed chambers support acoustic eigenmodes / standing waves.
Hard reflective surfaces can produce strong reverberation and narrow resonant coloration.
A room has multiple resonant modes rather than one universal magical note.
Structural vibration modes and air-acoustic room modes are different physical phenomena and must not be merged without measurement.
not_established: A pyramid spontaneously performs composed music.
A particular ancient pyramid was intentionally tuned to one modern musical frequency without archaeological and acoustic evidence.
A symbolic frequency is a physical causal mechanism merely because it is aesthetically meaningful.
epistemic_boundary.claim_policy: Calculated modes are predictions from a model. Measured impulse-response or spectral data outrank geometry-only estimates.

required.speed_of_sound_m_s: Default 343 m/s only as a nominal room-temperature value; use temperature/humidity-adjusted value when precision matters.

optional.measured_impulse_response: preferred for real reverberation and modal validation

core_equations.indices: p,q,r are non-negative integers and cannot all be zero

converter_pipeline.name: INGEST_GEOMETRY
converter_pipeline.instruction: Read dimensions and environmental parameters with units. Reject zero/negative dimensions and ambiguous units.

converter_pipeline.name: CALCULATE_MODAL_BANK
converter_pipeline.instruction: Enumerate p,q,r combinations, calculate f_pqr, classify axial/tangential/oblique modes, and retain the original physical frequency.

converter_pipeline.name: CLUSTER_NEAR_DEGENERATE_MODES
converter_pipeline.instruction: Group modes that fall within a configurable tolerance so that several geometric modes do not masquerade as independent musical notes.

converter_pipeline.name: MEASUREMENT_GATE
converter_pipeline.instruction: If an impulse response or measured spectrum exists, compare predicted modes with measured peaks and attach residual error, Q estimate and confidence.

converter_pipeline.name: PHYSICAL_AUDIO_RENDER
converter_pipeline.instruction: Use the physical modal frequencies as resonator/EQ targets. Do not octave-shift them in the physical render. Convolution with a measured impulse response is preferred when available.

converter_pipeline.name: CREATIVE_TRANSLATION_OPTION
converter_pipeline.instruction: For sub-audible or musically inconvenient modes, an optional creative copy may be octave-transposed. Preserve original_hz and transformation factor so the creative result cannot be confused with the physical mode.

converter_pipeline.name: AI_TEXTURE_LAYER
converter_pipeline.instruction: Use generative audio for texture, orchestration and ambience, not for precision frequency synthesis. Generate exact tones/resonator banks with DSP first when exact Hz matters.

converter_pipeline.name: EXPORT_RECEIPT
converter_pipeline.instruction: Export geometry, environment, equations, physical modes, any measured validation, creative transformations, prompt, seed/model metadata and output hashes.

rules: Measured peaks are labelled separately from predicted peaks.
Unknown absorption/Q values remain unknown rather than being silently guessed.

RECONSTRUCTION_MODE.goal: Approximate how a known source could sound inside the chamber
rules: If only geometry exists, label the result MODEL_BASED_RECONSTRUCTION.
Keep source type and source position explicit.

CREATIVE_TRANSLATION_MODE.goal: Turn physical resonances into music while preserving provenance
rules: Any pitch remapping must record original_hz, rendered_hz and transform.
Creative harmonics may be added, but must not be presented as measured chamber resonances.
Symbolic interpretation belongs to metadata, not to the physics field.

sub_audible_policy.measurement: retain original frequency even if below hearing range
sub_audible_policy.creative: multiply by powers of two until the copy enters the chosen audible range; retain the complete octave_shift receipt

example_transform.warning: 32.8 Hz is a creative translation of 16.4 Hz, not the original physical mode.

pyramid_calibration_preset.name: GREAT_PYRAMID_KINGS_CHAMBER_EXAMPLE
pyramid_calibration_preset.concept: Treat the chamber as a hard-walled resonant room for a first-order model, then replace the approximation with surveyed geometry and measured impulse-response data when available.

illustrative_long_axis_example.claim_boundary: Example calculation only; not a claim that the pyramid was intentionally tuned to this frequency.

pyramid_calibration_preset.important_note: The complete acoustic signature is a multi-mode spectrum affected by geometry, openings, material losses, source/listener positions and coupling to adjacent spaces.

pseudocode: if p == 0 and q == 0 and r == 0: continue
if f <= frequency_limit_hz: store(mode=(p,q,r), physical_hz=f, class=mode_class(p,q,r))
optionally validate against measured spectrum / impulse response
optionally create separately-labelled creative pitch mapping

generative_audio_bridge.stable_audio_note: Text-to-audio systems may not reproduce requested frequencies with laboratory precision. Exact modal tones should be synthesized or filtered with DSP and then combined with generated ambience.
generative_audio_bridge.prompt_template: Monumental ancient stone chamber ambience, long reflective granite-like reverberation, sparse low drone derived from supplied modal frequencies, restrained ritual percussion, no modern pop harmony unless requested, preserve a sense of huge enclosed architecture. Physical modal anchors: {MODE_HZ_LIST}. Creative octave translations, if any: {TRANSFORMED_MODE_LIST}. Do not describe symbolic frequencies as measured physical facts.

validation_gates.PHYSICS_TRACEABLE: every predicted frequency can be recomputed from saved inputs
validation_gates.MEASUREMENT_SEPARATED: predicted != measured unless matched by evidence
validation_gates.CREATIVE_TRANSFORMS_TRACEABLE: every remapped pitch preserves original_hz and transform
validation_gates.STRUCTURAL_VS_ACOUSTIC_SEPARATED: building vibration modes are not presented as room-air acoustic modes
validation_gates.AI_PRECISION_BOUNDARY: generative audio output is never treated as a precision frequency measurement

janus_operator: GEOMETRY -> MODE_SOLVER -> EVIDENCE_GATE -> PHYSICAL_SOUND -> OPTIONAL_CREATIVE_TRANSLATION -> AI_TEXTURE -> PROVENANCE_RECEIPT
one_line_rule: THE PYRAMID IS NOT ASSUMED TO PLAY A SONG; THE CHAMBER IS TREATED AS A RESONANT SYSTEM WHOSE PHYSICS CAN BE MEASURED, MODELLED, RENDERED AND THEN CREATIVELY TRANSLATED.

provenance.notes: Created as an instruction for a JANUS sound converter after discussion of pyramid/chamber acoustics and resonance.
